triage.question: How hard is it to fix this failed check of a Java build? Judge the work a fix needs, not how scary the message looks.

levels.easy: A mechanical or small obvious fix: formatting, an import, a license header, a typo, a missing semicolon, a style or analyzer finding in one file, a type or signature change at a few call sites.
levels.average: One failing test or runtime error whose cause is visible, or a few classes and tests to change together, or tests to add (a coverage threshold missed).
levels.hard: Needs investigation: many failing tests with one shared cause, concurrency, flaky or timing or order-dependent failures, memory, a migration or a build-wide change.
